region.description: Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints). Defaults to the Region set in the [provider configuration](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs#aws-configuration-reference).

error_document.description: Name of the error document for the website. [See below](#error_document).

key.description: Object key name to use when a 4XX class error occurs.

expected_bucket_owner.description: Account ID of the expected bucket owner.

index_document.description: Name of the index document for the website. [See below](#index_document).

suffix.description: Suffix that is appended to a request that is for a directory on the website endpoint. For example, if the suffix is `index.html` and you make a request to `samplebucket/images/`, the data that is returned will be for the object with the key name `images/index.html`. The suffix must not be empty and must not include a slash character.

redirect_all_requests_to.description: Redirect behavior for every request to this bucket's website endpoint. [See below](#redirect_all_requests_to). Conflicts with `error_document`, `index_document`, and `routing_rule`.

host_name.description: Name of the host where requests are redirected.

protocol.description: Protocol to use when redirecting requests. The default is the protocol that is used in the original request. Valid values: `http`, `https`.

routing_rule.description: List of rules that define when a redirect is applied and the redirect behavior. [See below](#routing_rule).

condition.description: Configuration block for describing a condition that must be met for the specified redirect to apply. [See below](#condition).

redirect.description: Configuration block for redirect information. [See below](#redirect).

routing_rules.description: JSON array containing [routing rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/aws-properties-s3-websiteconfiguration-routingrules.html) describing redirect behavior and when redirects are applied. Use this parameter when your routing rules contain empty String values (`""`) as seen in the [example above](#with-routing_rules-configured).
